# Resources Requirements Quality Checklist: R02-F04 — GPU resource ownership and pipeline lifetime

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the R02-F04 requirements: completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, lifecycle and
failure coverage, privacy and no-advertising, accessibility, simulator/device split, traceability.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Evaluated 2026-11-13 by the lead under the owner's standing delegation. One item failed first (CHK010); the
specification was corrected.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does every purpose item of the source prompt map to a requirement or a documented reuse? [Traceability, Spec §Absorbed]
- [x] CHK002 Is the audit's eviction defect stated with its consequence and a fixing requirement? [Completeness, Spec §Input, §FR-R02F04-010]
- [x] CHK003 Is amending (not deleting) the existing asserted test required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-R02F04-014]
- [x] CHK004 Are presets for common pipeline cases required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-R02F04-024]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "evicted program" lifetime defined (retired until release or context end)? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-R02F04-010, 011]
- [x] CHK006 Are the fields of the pipeline description listed exhaustively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-R02F04-020, Key Entities]
- [x] CHK007 Is the depth storage format specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-R02F04-030, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK008 Is the counter used for refused draws named? [Clarity, Spec §FR-R02F04-022]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Is the bounded cache (64) consistent with keeping evicted programs alive? [Consistency, Spec §FR-R02F04-012, 010]
- [x] CHK010 Is the fate of an evicted program dropped without release consistent with "zero live at close"? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases] — failed first: unstated; corrected: it stays retired and the registry releases it at context end (registry-owned, not a scene leak).
- [x] CHK011 Do default parameters keep existing callers' behavior unchanged? [Consistency, Spec §FR-R02F04-030, Clarifications]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 Are success criteria counted (pixels, fields, orders, storages, cache size, seconds)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-R02F04-001..006]
- [x] CHK013 Is "independent of prior state" made measurable with a fixed number of prior states? [Measurability, Spec §SC-R02F04-002]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are context loss, budget exceeded and incomplete framebuffer covered for depth targets? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-R02F04-032, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Is re-requesting an evicted variant while the old one is held defined? [Edge Case, Spec §US1 AC4]
- [x] CHK016 Are stale programs in a description covered? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-R02F04-022]
- [x] CHK017 Are memory pressure, cancellation and persisted data addressed with reasons? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional, Privacy, Accessibility, Device Split

- [x] CHK018 Is device GPU memory measurement separated as device-only, with simulator bytes called accounting? [Coverage, Spec §Input]
- [x] CHK019 Is accessibility recorded as not applicable with a reason? [Accessibility, Spec §Absorbed]
- [x] CHK020 Is it clear the feature adds no network, data collection or third-party code? [Privacy, Spec §Absorbed (copyright row)]
- [x] CHK021 Are test durations bounded? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-R02F04-006, FR-R02F04-041]
